$comment: SZL Holdings GitHub -> Hugging Face mirror map. Consumed by .github/workflows/hf-mirror.yml and scripts/hf_mirror_release.py. Org casing is literal: SZLHOLDINGS. Schema ported from szl-holdings/szl-lambda-gate@29a0bd9149bac28bb21e0ff4cf017dfb09a9805a; replace_hub_paths is the one addition.

targets.$why_no_card_tags: The live Hub card at main 654a01aaaf86d06471f019cf2f84305703ccc260 (read 2026-09-25) declares no tags and no doi: tag, so none is required. The publisher still requires the rendered front matter to equal the Hub baseline exactly.
targets.$why_preserve: Every Hub file the release must never overwrite: the seven Hub-only files, plus LICENSE, whose Hub bytes (553 B Apache-2.0 notice) differ from the GitHub full text (11358 B). LICENSE is preserved exactly as the lambda-gate proof did; moving it to replace_hub_paths is an owner decision.
targets.$why_replace: GitHub is the source of truth for code. These exact paths are the GitHub-owned files the release payload stages. When a Hub copy differs, the release may update it, and every replacement is printed with before and after sha256 and listed in the receipt. At Hub main 654a01aa, build.toml and torch-ext/szl_maskmod/__init__.py differ; the strict lambda-gate rule would fail closed on them. Any other staged path that collides with different Hub bytes still fails closed. The mirror never deletes a file.
targets.$why_no_push_lane: hub-sync propagates deletions. This Hub repo holds files that are not in the GitHub tree (bench and operational receipts, the CycloneDX BOM, maskmod.py, og-card.png and the Hub test). Mirroring runs only on release and only adds or updates files. The card is loaded from the Hub, so its curated front matter survives.
